basis: One retained actual TST-169 creation added exactly one blank line after each of three top-level headings. Approved/sent bytes matched; response/readback bytes matched each other. Exact confirmation correctly refused. The original uncertain operation and issue remain unchanged.
supported: Use CommonMark heading source maps to add one blank line after a top-level ATX or setext heading when following source content is not already separated.
Preserve existing separators, heading spelling, indentation, meaningful whitespace and original line endings. A heading at document end gains no content.
Fenced/indented code, HTML literals and nonheading hash text are not headings. Existing v3 link/list/terminal-LF behavior remains unchanged.
Already separated container headings retain their source bytes. Unseparated blockquote/list headings refuse before approval instead of inserting a line that could change container structure.

legacy.confirmed: Only exact saved, confirmed and linked submissions replay under their original scoped approval and current policy, without current rendering or new effects.
legacy.unsubmitted_or_uncertain: Old approvals cannot acquire v4 meaning. Original uncertainty and exact readback remain; no old body or approval is rewritten.

cases.HS01: Retained actual description and response difference is reproduced locally; an independently authored provider hook adds the observed three separators.
cases.HS02: ATX levels, closing hashes, setext and consecutive headings gain only missing separators; already separated and terminal headings are idempotent.
cases.HS03: Code, nested fences, literal quotes, HTML, nonheading hashes, line endings and whitespace remain exact; unseparated container headings refuse before writing artifacts.
cases.HS04: Actual local Writer review approves v4 bytes before HTTP submission; exact readback confirms and repeats without another mutation.
cases.HS05: Changed provider bytes remain uncertain; v3 confirmed replay, unused approval and uncertain history preserve original meaning and no new effect authority.
cases.HS06: Existing v1/v2 history and affected link/list/literal/writing/intake/progress controls remain passing on the changed source.

controls: tests/application/test_linear_headings.py and affected existing application/linear/writing tests
limits: Local provider, review and authority observations are explicitly authored. No live provider, credential, model, tunnel or TST-169 recovery effects. A fresh separately reviewed installed case must establish actual provider preservation.
